author: Cal86
quote: It's sad to see how this series has turned out. Rockstar's logic is that you're forbidden to commit an array of criminal activities in a series that became famous for its freedom of choices and it's ability to commit crime. Rockstar needs to fire its predominantly female/liberal/woke team and return to its roots. They may receive artificially pumped top ratings from so called gaming critics, but the fans have spoken and we don't like this streaming pile of garbage.
